list_namespaces.title: List metric namespaces
list_namespaces.description: List the cloud services that publish metrics, with their namespaces. Start here to find the namespace for a product.

labels.description: JSON array string of label filters.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_metric_definitions.title: List metrics in a namespace
list_metric_definitions.description: List the metrics a namespace publishes, with their units, periods, statistics and dimensions.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

get_metric_data.title: Get metric data
get_metric_data.description: Read a metric's data points for resources over a time window, paginated with NextToken. Use this for time series.

namespace.description: The metric namespace, e.g. acs_ecs_dashboard for ECS or acs_rds_dashboard for RDS.

dimensions.description: JSON array string of dimension maps, e.g. [{"instanceId":"i-bp1a5ifihqel4****"}].

period.description: Seconds per data point, e.g. 60 or 300.

start_time.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: End, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

next_token.description: The NextToken from the previous page.

output.description: Datapoints (a JSON string) and a NextToken.

get_latest_metric_data.title: Get the latest metric values
get_latest_metric_data.description: Read the most recent data point of a metric for each resource, for a current-state check.

namespace.description: The metric namespace, e.g. acs_ecs_dashboard for ECS or acs_rds_dashboard for RDS.

dimensions.description: JSON array string of dimension maps, e.g. [{"instanceId":"i-bp1a5ifihqel4****"}].

period.description: Seconds per data point, e.g. 60 or 300.

start_time.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: End, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

next_token.description: The NextToken from the previous page.

get_top_metric_data.title: Rank resources by a metric
get_top_metric_data.description: Rank resources by a metric in a window, such as the ECS instances with the highest CPU.

namespace.description: The metric namespace, e.g. acs_ecs_dashboard for ECS or acs_rds_dashboard for RDS.

orderby.description: The statistic to sort by, e.g. Average or Maximum.

dimensions.description: JSON array string of dimension maps, e.g. [{"instanceId":"i-bp1a5ifihqel4****"}].

period.description: Seconds per data point, e.g. 60 or 300.

start_time.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: End, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

list_alarm_rules.title: List alert rules
list_alarm_rules.description: List metric alert rules with their thresholds, resources, contact groups, and whether each is enabled and currently alerting.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

put_alarm_rule.title: Create or update an alert rule
put_alarm_rule.description: Create or update a threshold alert rule for a metric on specific resources. A critical threshold is set here; the rule notifies its contact groups when it is breached for 'times' periods.

rule_id.description: The rule ID; an existing ID updates that rule.

namespace.description: The metric namespace, e.g. acs_ecs_dashboard for ECS or acs_rds_dashboard for RDS.

resources.description: JSON array string of the resources, e.g. [{"instanceId":"i-bp1a5ifihqel4****"}].

contact_groups.description: Comma-separated contact group names to notify.

webhook.description: A URL to call on alert.

enable_alarm_rule.title: Enable an alert rule
enable_alarm_rule.description: Enable a disabled alert rule so it evaluates and notifies again.

disable_alarm_rule.title: Disable an alert rule
disable_alarm_rule.description: Disable an alert rule; it stops notifying until enabled again.

delete_alarm_rule.title: Delete an alert rule
delete_alarm_rule.description: Delete an alert rule and stop its notifications.

list_alert_logs.title: List alert history
list_alert_logs.description: List alerts that fired in a window, with their rule, resource, level and notification status.

start_time.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: End, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_contacts.title: List alert contacts
list_contacts.description: List alert contacts with their email, SMS and DingTalk channels.

chanel_type.description: Filter by channel type, e.g. Mail.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

put_contact.title: Create or update an alert contact
put_contact.description: Create or update an alert contact and the channels that reach them.

delete_contact.title: Delete an alert contact
delete_contact.description: Delete an alert contact; they stop receiving notifications.

list_contact_groups.title: List contact groups
list_contact_groups.description: List alert contact groups, which alert rules notify.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

put_contact_group.title: Create or update a contact group
put_contact_group.description: Create or update an alert contact group with one member contact.

contact_name.description: A contact to put in the group.

delete_contact_group.title: Delete a contact group
delete_contact_group.description: Delete a contact group; rules that notify it reach no one through it.

list_groups.title: List application groups
list_groups.description: List application groups, which bundle resources across products for shared alert rules and dashboards.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_group.title: Create an application group
create_group.description: Create an application group to monitor a set of resources together.

delete_group.title: Delete an application group
delete_group.description: Delete an application group and its group-level alert rules.

list_group_resources.title: List resources in a group
list_group_resources.description: List the resources in an application group.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_site_monitors.title: List availability monitors
list_site_monitors.description: List site (availability) monitoring tasks that probe URLs and hosts from many locations.

task_type.description: Filter by probe type, e.g. HTTP, PING, TCP.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_site_monitor.title: Create an availability monitor
create_site_monitor.description: Create a monitoring task that probes a URL or host on an interval from chosen locations.

address.description: The URL or host to probe.

isp_cities.description: JSON array string of probe locations, e.g. [{"city":"546","isp":"465"}].

options_json.description: JSON string of probe options such as http_method or timeout.

delete_site_monitors.title: Delete availability monitors
delete_site_monitors.description: Delete monitoring tasks, optionally with their alert rules.

get_site_monitor_data.title: Get availability data
get_site_monitor_data.description: Read a monitoring task's response time or availability over a window.

start_time.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: End, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

period.description: Seconds per data point, e.g. 60 or 300.

next_token.description: The NextToken from the previous page.

put_custom_metric.title: Report a custom metric
put_custom_metric.description: Report one custom metric value for an application group, for alerting on business data.

values.description: A JSON string of values, e.g. {"value":10.5}.

dimensions.description: A JSON string of dimensions, e.g. {"service":"checkout"}.

time.description: The timestamp, e.g. 2026-11-12T10:00:00.000+0800, or a Unix time in ms.

list_custom_metrics.title: List custom metrics
list_custom_metrics.description: List reported custom metrics for an application group.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

put_custom_event.title: Report a custom event
put_custom_event.description: Report one custom event for an application group, such as a deployment or a business exception.

list_system_events.title: List system events
list_system_events.description: List cloud system events, such as instance restarts for maintenance or disk failures, in a window.

start_time.description: Start, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: End, as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss or a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_event_rules.title: List event rules
list_event_rules.description: List event-triggered alert rules and their targets.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

get_agent_status.title: Get monitoring agent status
get_agent_status.description: Check whether the CloudMonitor agent is installed and running on ECS instances.
